summary: Strong pair on D1.4 ordering. Position-not-count trap is grade-appropriate with concrete recovery; puppets explicitly optional with no-prep substitutes; tie-handling and stretch task included; worksheet varies format (circle/underline, then number, then build). Math authenticity is solid Level 3 (precise greatest/least vocab, count-then-order reasoning) but does not reach Level 4 — children do not invent or compare strategies, and the trap is not framed in research-grounded terms (e.g., Friel/Curcio graph-comprehension levels).
